keyQuotes: HPC-Ops has fully evolved from a single high-performance operator library into a system-level inference optimization capability set that covers the entire large model inference process, balances precision and speed, and is adapted for large-scale production deployment.

All optimization capabilities in this release are derived from the long-term online production practices of the Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra team, deeply adapted to real, complex large-scale inference business scenarios.

mainPoints.explanation: This upgrade focuses on five core operators: Attention, Router GEMM, FusedMoE, Fused AllReduce+Norm, and Sampler, shifting from single-point performance optimization to full-link collaborative optimization, resulting in a 30% end-to-end QPM improvement.
mainPoints.point: HPC-Ops has evolved from individual operators to a system-level optimization capability set covering the entire inference pipeline.

mainPoints.explanation: Through tile-level splitting, global load balancing, and a greedy bin-packing algorithm, it achieves a 1.59x-1.76x speedup in mixed-length batch scenarios and up to a 2.95x speedup in single-batch long-text scenarios.
mainPoints.point: The Attention dynamic scheduling solution effectively addresses the long-tail latency issue caused by mixed-length request batching.

mainPoints.explanation: It splits FP32 weights into high-bit and low-bit residual BF16 tensors, performs two BF16 GEMM operations during inference, and combines them linearly. Its precision significantly surpasses TF32, with performance up to 3.22x faster than FP32 cuBLAS.
mainPoints.point: Router GEMM achieves FP32-level precision with a dual BF16 combination, balancing accuracy and performance.

mainPoints.explanation: It fuses five stages—routing, Gate-Up GEMM, activation quantization, Down GEMM, and Top-K aggregation—into a unified pipeline, eliminating memory copy and kernel launch overhead, achieving a 1.2x-1.6x performance improvement over mainstream frameworks.
mainPoints.point: FusedMoE significantly reduces MoE inference overhead through a full-operator pipeline reconstruction.

mainPoints.explanation: It fuses over a dozen fragmented kernels into 2 CUDA kernels through full-process kernel fusion, fine-grained parallelism, and computation chain consolidation, achieving a 4.0x-7.5x speedup over vLLM.
mainPoints.point: Sampler eliminates post-processing performance bottlenecks through extreme large-kernel fusion.

oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan open-sources a major upgrade to its HPC-Ops inference operator library, introducing five core operators including Attention dynamic scheduling, Router GEMM dual BF16 high-precision computation, and FusedMoE full pipeline, with multiple performance metrics surpassing mainstream baselines and end-to-end QPM improved by 30%.
originalTitle: 腾讯混元 AI Infra 新开源：HPC-Ops 推理核心算子全面升级
summary: This article is an official release from the Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra team regarding a major upgrade to its open-source inference operator library, HPC-Ops. It details the technical principles, design concepts, and performance data of five core operators: Attention adopts runtime dynamic load scheduling to address long-tail latency, achieving a 2.95x speedup for long-text scenarios; Router GEMM uses a dual BF16 combination to simulate FP32 precision, achieving up to a 3.22x speedup over FP32 cuBLAS while maintaining high accuracy; FusedMoE integrates the entire MoE inference process into a unified pipeline, delivering a 1.2x-1.6x performance improvement over vLLM/SGLang; Fused AllReduce+Norm deeply fuses communication and normalization computation, achieving up to a 1.68x speedup; Sampler fuses over a dozen kernels into 2, achieving a 4.0x-7.5x speedup over vLLM. All capabilities are derived from Tencent Hunyuan's online production practices and have been fully open-sourced.
title: Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra New Open Source: Comprehensive Upgrade of HPC-Ops Inference Core Operators
